hero.title: Web Developer
hero.subtitle: Based in Cardiff, working worldwide
hero.p1: Hi, my name is Anna and I am a freelance web developer.
hero.p3-3: , I'm here for your small business or collaborative team.

service.service-1-description-1: I specialize in creating websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, ensuring each site is tailored to your unique needs with custom functionalities.
service.service-1-description-2: I'm proficient in building dynamic, responsive websites using React framework, and I'm adept at working with other React-based frameworks.
service.service-2-description-1: Whether you need to tweak an existing theme or create a new custom WordPress theme, I have the skills to deliver exactly what your brand requires.
service.service-2-description-2: I can develop bespoke WordPress plugins, enhancing your site's functionality with tailored PHP solutions.
service.service-3-description-1: If you prefer a different CMS, let's discuss it! I'm open to working with various CMS platforms to find the perfect fit for your project.
service.service-4-caption-1: Relocate your website to a new host:
service.service-4-description-1: I can manage the migration process smoothly, ensuring your site's integrity and minimizing downtime.
service.service-5: Comprehensive Care for Your Online Presence:
service.service-5-description-1: Expert support with hosting and server management to keep your website running smoothly and efficiently.
service.service-5-description-2: efficient troubleshooting to tackle any challenges.
service.service-5-description-3: Tailored script development for unique website functionalities.
service.service-5-description-4: I help organize and optimize the storage and processing of your website’s data — from setting up databases to integrating external services and systems.
service.service-5-description-5: Regular updates and maintenance to ensure a seamless online experience.

portfolio.ludesign-approach-p1: showcases the work of Ludmila Stepashina, a talented designer and illustrator. This site serves as a professional portfolio highlighting her skills and projects.
portfolio.ludesign-approach-p2: Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript using Bootstrap for responsive design, the website offers a clean, modern look and a user-friendly experience.
portfolio.ludesign-approach-p3: The use of high-quality images effectively showcases her portfolio, highlighting the range and depth of her design capabilities. The overall design, including the color scheme and typography, aligns seamlessly with her professional branding and style.
portfolio.sozo-approach-p1: is a well-crafted WordPress site, customized to showcase design and interior decoration services. It features an aesthetically pleasing and modern design, enhanced by HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.
portfolio.sozo-approach-p2: With its responsive layout, the site ensures seamless navigation and viewing on various devices. JavaScript enhancements provide advanced user interaction, while PHP customizations contribute to dynamic content functionality, demonstrating a harmonious blend of design and technical expertise in web development.
portfolio.art-approach-p1: The website Art Inspiration is an artist's portfolio that represents a custom adaptation of a WordPress theme, designed to create an online gallery. It incorporates interactive elements through custom JavaScript, adding depth to the user experience.
portfolio.art-approach-p2: Offering a distinctive approach to layout and design, the site effectively showcases art pieces, leveraging a responsive framework for seamless viewing on various devices. This project showcases the perfect blend of creative design and interactive web technologies.
portfolio.webdev-p1: This website is a personal portfolio for a freelance web developer offering a variety of web services. It demonstrates a collection of web development projects showcasing skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, WordPress, and game development. Each project is designed with a focus on functionality, user experience, and coding best practices.
portfolio.webdev-p2: The website itself is built with React, using Styled Components, and implements some standard security features to ensure secure communication between the user and the website. This site is mobile and SEO-friendly. It includes a portfolio section, services overview, a contact form, and a fun section with a game, all crafted to highlight full-stack development skills while maintaining scalability for future growth.

contacts.description-1: Need a website that captures the essence of your business? I specialize in creating custom, engaging websites that help small businesses and entrepreneurs stand out and grow.
contacts.description-2: As a passionate web developer, I love working with startups and innovative projects. If you're looking for a tech partner to bring your vision to life, you're in the right place.
contacts.description-3: I'm always excited to connect with other professionals. Whether you're a freelancer, a company looking for a freelance developer, or someone who wants to discuss a potential partnership, let's talk!
contacts.description-4: I'm just an email or message away. Contact me for any web development needs, questions, or just to say hi. Together, we can create a website that not only meets but exceeds your expectations.
contacts.p1: Feel free to reach out to me via email
